# chart

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/chart"
```

Package chart draws numbers in cells: Area and Spark a run of them over time, the newest on the right, and Bars a few side by side, one row each. Every cell is cut to an eighth, so a bar or a column grows smoothly.

<a name="Area"></a>
## func [Area](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/chart.go#L50>)

```go
func Area(values []float64, top float64, width, height int, th theme.Resolved, opts ...Option) string
```

Area is the last width values as columns height rows tall, scaled so top fills them, each row coloured along the theme's ramp from the bottom up. Fewer values than columns leave the left blank.

<a name="Bars"></a>
## func [Bars](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/bars.go#L30>)

```go
func Bars(bars []Bar, top float64, width int, th theme.Resolved, opts ...Option) string
```

Bars is one row per bar, width cells wide: the labels in a column, each bar scaled so top fills it, its edge cut to an eighth, and its text right\-aligned at the end. A long label is cut before the bars give up any room.

<a name="Donut"></a>
## func [Donut](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/donut.go#L16>)

```go
func Donut(value, total float64, size int, th theme.Resolved) string
```

Donut is a ring size rows tall and twice as wide, filled clockwise from the top by value's share of total, with the share in its middle: a quota, a disk, a goal. Animate value with a Float to sweep it in.

<a name="Fill"></a>
## func [Fill](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/chart.go#L27>)

```go
func Fill(th theme.Resolved, opts ...Option) lipgloss.Style
```

Fill is the style a bar or a line in opts is filled with: the theme's i\-th series colour under InSeries\(i\), the accent otherwise. progress.Smooth reads it too, so one InSeries serves both packages.

<a name="Heat"></a>
## func [Heat](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/heat.go#L12>)

```go
func Heat(values [][]float64, top float64, th theme.Resolved) string
```

Heat is values as a grid of cells two columns wide, each coloured along the theme's ramp by its share of top; a value at or below zero is a muted dot.

<a name="Spark"></a>
## func [Spark](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/chart.go#L75>)

```go
func Spark(values []float64, top float64, width int, th theme.Resolved, opts ...Option) string
```

Spark is the last width values as one row, scaled to top, in the accent.

<a name="Bar"></a>
## type [Bar](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/bars.go#L17-L22>)

Bar is one row of Bars: what it measures, how much, and the text after it, Value printed when empty. Style paints this bar alone, as a threshold would; nil keeps the chart's colour.

```go
type Bar struct {
    Label string
    Value float64
    Text  string
    Style *lipgloss.Style
}
```

<a name="Option"></a>
## type [Option](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/chart.go#L16>)

Option changes how a chart is drawn.

```go
type Option func(*look)
```

<a name="InSeries"></a>
### func [InSeries](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/chart/chart.go#L22>)

```go
func InSeries(i int) Option
```

InSeries draws the chart whole in the theme's i\-th series colour, instead of along the ramp \(Area\) or in the accent \(Spark\).
